title: Cord-Cutting Guides: IPTV vs Cable vs Satellite Costs
description: Honest comparisons of IPTV, cable and satellite for UK and US households: what you really pay, what you give up, and how to build a legal setup.
intro: Cutting the cord is less about one magic service and more about matching what you actually watch to the cheapest legal combination of broadcast, streaming and on-demand. These guides lay out the trade-offs without hype.

faq.question: Is IPTV cheaper than cable?
faq.answer: It depends on which licensed services you need. Broadcaster apps and FAST channels are free; premium sport and film packages are not. Our comparisons break down typical bundles for the UK and US.
